title: Capstone, Review & Community Science
intro: The year's physics consolidated: drills, exam skills, a team capstone build and a community science day.

lessons.title: The Year in Physics: The Big Map
lessons.focus: Whole-year concept map built by the class on the wall: forces → motion → energy → machines → fluids → waves.
lessons.advanced: Add three cross-links nobody else found (e.g., resonance ↔ shock absorbers) and defend them.

lessons.title: Core Drill I: Measurement and Forces
lessons.focus: Speed-round problems: units, conversions, force diagrams, friction cases; peer marking with schemes.
lessons.advanced: Write the two hardest fair questions you can from Units 1–2, with schemes.

lessons.title: Core Drill II: Motion and Gravity
lessons.focus: Graph reading, speed/velocity/acceleration, fall and projectile computations; game-show format.
lessons.advanced: Mixed problem: throw up at 12 m/s from 2 m — time to land and impact speed.

lessons.title: Core Drill III: Energy and Machines
lessons.focus: Work/power/efficiency chains; MA/VR on levers and pulleys; identify machines in photos.
lessons.advanced: A tackle lifts 600 N with 200 N effort over 4 strands: MA, VR, efficiency, and the diagnosis.

lessons.title: Core Drill IV: Pressure, Fluids and Buoyancy
lessons.focus: P=F/A, P=ρgh, siphon reasoning, Archimedes cases; lab-practical style stations.
lessons.advanced: Design-question: lift 100 kg with a hydraulic jack — specify plunger areas and strokes.

lessons.title: Core Drill V: Circles, Oscillations and Momentum
lessons.focus: v=2πr/T, pendulum T=2π√(L/g), p=mv collisions; mini-whiteboard showdown.
lessons.advanced: Cart 2 kg at 3 m/s catches a 1 kg cart at rest (sticky): final speed and KE accounting.

lessons.title: Core Drill VI: Materials, Wind/Water and Sound
lessons.focus: Hooke's law, structures, windmill data, v=fλ; practical data questions from the year's own logs.
lessons.advanced: From the windmill log, estimate annual water delivered; state assumptions and uncertainty.

lessons.title: Exam Skills: Reading CBE-Style Questions
lessons.focus: Command words (state, explain, calculate, justify); structured answers; time budgeting; common traps.
lessons.advanced: Mark two sample answers with the official-style scheme; write the feedback.

lessons.title: Practical Skills Review: Plan a Fair Test in 20 Minutes
lessons.focus: Given a mystery question ('does blade angle matter?'), plan: variables, method, table, safety, expected graph.
lessons.advanced: Add the analysis plan: graph choice, gradient meaning, uncertainty statement.

lessons.title: Capstone I: Choose the Challenge
lessons.focus: Teams pick: windmill upgrade, pump/siphon system, bridge-plus, instrument ensemble, or an approved new idea; write the brief and roles.
lessons.advanced: Include measurable success criteria and a test plan in the brief.

lessons.title: Capstone II: Prototype
lessons.focus: Gather materials, prototype the risky part first; teacher check-ins against the brief.
lessons.advanced: Log the riskiest assumption and the prototype result that retired it.

lessons.title: Capstone III: Build and Test
lessons.focus: Full build; data collection plan executed; first failures documented honestly.
lessons.advanced: Mid-build report: what the data says vs the brief; the pivot you made and why.

lessons.title: Capstone IV: Iterate and Document
lessons.focus: One measured improvement cycle; finish documentation with diagrams and data tables.
lessons.advanced: Final numbers: performance, efficiency, cost, and a realistic maintenance plan.

lessons.title: Capstone V: Poster and Rehearsal
lessons.focus: Poster with problem, physics, data, result; rehearse the 3-minute demo; peer feedback round.
lessons.advanced: Prepare the two hardest audience questions for your project and the answers.

lessons.title: Community Science Day
lessons.focus: Parents, fundis and leaders invited; teams run stations of the year's builds; capstones premiered; guest feedback cards.
lessons.advanced: Collect and summarize guest feedback quantitatively (ratings tally) for the class report.

lessons.title: Reflection and Portfolio
lessons.focus: Each learner compiles best pre/post tests, graphs and build photos; writes 'what I can now do' against CBE outcomes.
lessons.advanced: Self-assess against ten key outcomes with evidence citations from your portfolio.

lessons.title: Celebration and Next Year's Teaser
lessons.focus: Certificates; dynamo and solar teasers for Electricity & Magnetism next year; the class physics pledge.
lessons.advanced: Preview problem: the windmill spins a dynamo — sketch the full energy chain to a lit bulb with efficiencies.
